title: Hanuma continues search for Seetha
introduction: Realizing that the woman he saw at Ravana's house was not Seetha, Hanuma begins to search again for Seetha.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकादशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 11th chapter in Sundara Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
अवधूय च ताम् बुद्धिम् बभूव अवस्थितः तदा |
जगाम च अपराम् चिन्ताम् सीताम् प्रति महा कपिः
verses.iast:
avadhūya ca tām buddhim babhūva avasthitaḥ tadā |
jagāma ca aparām cintām sītām prati mahā kapiḥ
verses.translation: The great Hanuma then removing that thought became with the right mind and had another thought about Seetha.

glosses.meaning: became avasthitaH = with the right mind

verses.devanagari:
न रामेण वियुक्ता सा स्वप्तुम् अर्हति भामिनी |
न भोक्तुम् न अपि अलम्कर्तुम् न पानम् उपसेवितुम्
न अन्यम् नरम् उपस्थातुम् सुराणाम् अपि च ईश्वरम् |
न हि राम समः कश्चिद् विद्यते त्रिदशेष्व् अपि
अन्या इयम् इति निश्चित्य पान भूमौ चचार सः |
verses.iast:
na rāmeṇa viyuktā sā svaptum arhati bhāminī |
na bhoktum na api alamkartum na pānam upasevitum
na anyam naram upasthātum surāṇām api ca īśvaram |
na hi rāma samaḥ kaścid vidyate tridaśeṣv api
anyā iyam iti niścitya pāna bhūmau cacāra saḥ |
verses.translation: That Seetha is not suitable to sleep separated from Rama, will not eat, will not decorate also, not suited to drink a beverage, to reach another man even though if he were Indra because there is indeed no one equaling Rama even among gods. This is another woman - thus deciding that Hanuma paced in that banqueting hall.

verses.devanagari:
क्रीडितेन अपराः क्लान्ता गीतेन च तथा पराः
नृत्तेन च अपराः क्लान्ताः पान विप्रहताः तथा |
verses.iast:
krīḍitena aparāḥ klāntā gītena ca tathā parāḥ
nṛttena ca aparāḥ klāntāḥ pāna viprahatāḥ tathā |
verses.translation: Some women were tired from erotic dalliance and then some other women were tired from singing; some others were weary from dance and were unconscious from consumption of liquor.

glosses.meaning: were unconscious from consumption of liquor.

verses.devanagari:
मुरजेषु म्ऱ्दन्गेषु पीठिकासु च संस्थिताः
तथा आस्तरण मुख्य्येषु सम्विष्टाः च अपराः स्त्रियः |
verses.iast:
murajeṣu mRdangeṣu pīṭhikāsu ca saṃsthitāḥ
tathā āstaraṇa mukhyyeṣu samviṣṭāḥ ca aparāḥ striyaḥ |
verses.translation: Some women were stationed on tabors, on Mrudangas, on seats, some other women rested on chief carpets.

verses.devanagari:
अङ्गनानाम् सहस्रेण भूषितेन विभूषणैः
रूप सम्ल्लाप शीलेन युक्त गीत अर्थ भाषिणा |
देश काल अभियुक्तेन युक्त वाक्य अभिधायिना
रत अभिरत संसुप्तम् ददर्श हरि यूथपः |
verses.iast:
aṇ^ganānām sahasreṇa bhūṣitena vibhūṣaṇaiḥ
rūpa samllāpa śīlena yukta gīta artha bhāṣiṇā |
deśa kāla abhiyuktena yukta vākya abhidhāyinā
rata abhirata saṃsuptam dadarśa hari yūthapaḥ |
verses.translation: The warrior among Vanaras saw a thousand of women decorated by jewellery with a nature of talking about beauty, conversing about the correct meaning of songs being sung, behaving according to time and place, wont to speak appropriate words, indulged in sleep after sexual dalliance.

glosses.meaning: with a nature of talking about beauty
conversing about the correct meaning of songs(being sung) deshakaalaabhiyuktena = behaving according to time and place
indulged in sleep after sexual dalliance.

verses.devanagari:
तासाम् मध्ये महा बाहुः शुशुभे राक्षस ईश्वरः
गोष्ठे महति मुख्यानाम् गवाम् मध्ये यथा वृषः |
verses.iast:
tāsām madhye mahā bāhuḥ śuśubhe rākṣasa īśvaraḥ
goṣṭhe mahati mukhyānām gavām madhye yathā vṛṣaḥ |
verses.translation: In the middle of that group of women, Ravana with great arms shone like a bull in the middle of cows in a big cow-pen.

verses.devanagari:
स राक्षस इन्द्रः शुशुभे ताभिः परिवृतः स्वयम्
करेणुभिर् यथा अरण्यम् परिकीर्णो महा द्विपः |
verses.iast:
sa rākṣasa indraḥ śuśubhe tābhiḥ parivṛtaḥ svayam
kareṇubhir yathā araṇyam parikīrṇo mahā dvipaḥ |
verses.translation: That Ravana himself surrounded by those women, shone like a great elephant surrounded by she elephants in a great forest.

verses.devanagari:
सर्व कामैर् उपेताम् च पान भूमिम् महात्मनः
ददर्श कपि शार्दूलः तस्य रक्षः पतेर् गृहे |
verses.iast:
sarva kāmair upetām ca pāna bhūmim mahātmanaḥ
dadarśa kapi śārdūlaḥ tasya rakṣaḥ pater gṛhe |
verses.translation: The best among Vanaras saw in that wealthy Ravana's house a bar also, consisting of all desirables.

verses.devanagari:
मृगाणाम् महिषाणाम् च वराहाणाम् च भागशः
तत्र न्यस्तानि मांसानि पान भूमौ ददर्श सः |
verses.iast:
mṛgāṇām mahiṣāṇām ca varāhāṇām ca bhāgaśaḥ
tatra nyastāni māṃsāni pāna bhūmau dadarśa saḥ |
verses.translation: Hanuma saw there in that bar, meat of dear and of buffalo, of wild boar kept separately.

verses.devanagari:
रौक्मेषु च विशलेषु भाजनेष्व् अर्ध भक्षितान्
ददर्श कपि शार्दूल मयूरान् कुक्कुटामः तथा |
verses.iast:
raukmeṣu ca viśaleṣu bhājaneṣv ardha bhakṣitān
dadarśa kapi śārdūla mayūrān kukkuṭāmḥ tathā |
verses.translation: The best among Vanaras saw half eaten peacocks and chicken in wide vessels of golden colour.

verses.devanagari:
वराह वार्ध्राणसकान् दधि सौवर्चल आयुतान्
शल्यान् म्ऱ्ग मयूरामः च हनूमान् अन्ववैक्षत |
verses.iast:
varāha vārdhrāṇasakān dadhi sauvarcala āyutān
śalyān mRga mayūrāmḥ ca hanūmān anvavaikṣata |
verses.translation: Hanuma observed meat of pigs and goats, porcupines, deer and peacocks preserved in curds and sochal salt.

glosses.meaning: preserved in curds and sochal salt.

verses.devanagari:
कृकरान् विविधान् सिद्धामः चकोरान् अर्ध भक्षितान्
महिषान् एक शल्यामः च चागामः च कृत निष्ठितान् |
लेख्यम् उच्च अवचम् पेयम् भोज्यानि विविधानि च
verses.iast:
kṛkarān vividhān siddhāmḥ cakorān ardha bhakṣitān
mahiṣān eka śalyāmḥ ca cāgāmḥ ca kṛta niṣṭhitān |
lekhyam ucca avacam peyam bhojyāni vividhāni ca
verses.translation: Hanuma saw birds called Krakara cooked ready to be eaten in variety of ways, birds called Chakoras half eaten, wild buffalos, fishes called ekashleya, goats, food to be licked of various kinds, beverages and various foods.

glosses.meaning: cooked ready(to be eaten) in variety of ways

verses.devanagari:
तथा अम्ल लवण उत्तंसैर् विविधै राग षाडवैः |
हार नूपुर केयूरैर् अपविद्धैर् महा धनैः
पान भाजन विक्षिप्तैः फलैः च विविधैर् अपि |
कृत पुष्प उपहारा भूर् अधिकम् पुष्यति श्रियम्
verses.iast:
tathā amla lavaṇa uttaṃsair vividhai rāga ṣāḍavaiḥ |
hāra nūpura keyūrair apaviddhair mahā dhanaiḥ
pāna bhājana vikṣiptaiḥ phalaiḥ ca vividhair api |
kṛta puṣpa upahārā bhūr adhikam puṣyati śriyam
verses.translation: In the same way that floor was obtaining glory greatly with Ragas and Shadabas seasoned with sour and salty sauces, with necklaces, anklets and armlets of great value thrown around, with various fruits left in drinking vessels, with flowers sprinkled.

glosses.meaning: seasoned with sour and salty sauces

verses.devanagari:
तत्र तत्र च विन्यस्तैः सुश्लिष्टैः शयन आसनैः |
पान भूमिर् विना वह्निम् प्रदीप्ता इव उपलक्ष्यते
verses.iast:
tatra tatra ca vinyastaiḥ suśliṣṭaiḥ śayana āsanaiḥ |
pāna bhūmir vinā vahnim pradīptā iva upalakṣyate
verses.translation: That bar was seen as though radiant without fire, with couches and chairs well arranged and placed there and there.

verses.devanagari:
बहु प्रकारैर् विविधैर् वर संस्कार संस्कृतैः |
मांसैः कुशल सम्युक्तैः पान भूमि गतैः पृथक्
verses.iast:
bahu prakārair vividhair vara saṃskāra saṃskṛtaiḥ |
māṃsaiḥ kuśala samyuktaiḥ pāna bhūmi gataiḥ pṛthak
verses.translation: Many meats of different kinds cultured with various best seasonings, well arranged separately obtained that bar.

verses.devanagari:
दिव्याः प्रसन्ना विविधाः सुराः कृत सुरा अपि |
शर्कर आसव माध्वीकाः पुष्प आसव फल आसवाः
वास चूर्णैः च विविधैर् मृष्टाः तैः तैः पृथक् पृथक् |
verses.iast:
divyāḥ prasannā vividhāḥ surāḥ kṛta surā api |
śarkara āsava mādhvīkāḥ puṣpa āsava phala āsavāḥ
vāsa cūrṇaiḥ ca vividhair mṛṣṭāḥ taiḥ taiḥ pṛthak pṛthak |
verses.translation: Excellent and clear various liquors, a liquor called Sura, liquor made of sugar, liquor made of honey, liquor made of flowers and liquors made of fruits also, artificially made liquors - those and those were cultured separately with various fragrant powders.

verses.devanagari:
सम्तता शुशुभे भूमिर् माल्यैः च बहु संस्थितैः
हिरण्मयैः च करकैर् भाजनैः स्फाटिकैर् अपि |
जाम्बूनदमयैश्चान्याः करकैरभिवम्वृता
verses.iast:
samtatā śuśubhe bhūmir mālyaiḥ ca bahu saṃsthitaiḥ
hiraṇmayaiḥ ca karakair bhājanaiḥ sphāṭikair api |
jāmbūnadamayaiścānyāḥ karakairabhivamvṛtā
verses.translation: The floor shone filled by flower garlands in a variety of forms, with various vessels of golden hue and also made of crystal, filled with other small vessels of golden colour.

verses.devanagari:
राजतेषु च कुम्भेषु जाम्बूनदमयेषु च |
पान श्रेष्ठम् तदा भूरि कपिः तत्र ददर्श ह
verses.iast:
rājateṣu ca kumbheṣu jāmbūnadamayeṣu ca |
pāna śreṣṭham tadā bhūri kapiḥ tatra dadarśa ha
verses.translation: Hanuma saw indeed then lot of best quality liquor in pots of silver and of golden colour.

verses.devanagari:
सो अपश्यत् शात कुम्भानि शीधोर् मणिमयानि च |
राजतानि च पूर्णानि भाजनानि महा कपिः
verses.iast:
so apaśyat śāta kumbhāni śīdhor maṇimayāni ca |
rājatāni ca pūrṇāni bhājanāni mahā kapiḥ
verses.translation: That great Hanuma saw vessels full of liquor of golden colour, embedded with gem stones and also of silver hue.

verses.devanagari:
क्वचिद् अर्ध अवशेषाणि क्वचित् पीतानि सर्वशः |
क्वचिन् न एव प्रपीतानि पानानि स ददर्श ह
verses.iast:
kvacid ardha avaśeṣāṇi kvacit pītāni sarvaśaḥ |
kvacin na eva prapītāni pānāni sa dadarśa ha
verses.translation: That Hanuma saw indeed at some places drinks half filled and at some places completely drunk and some places not at all drunk.

verses.devanagari:
क्वचिद् भक्ष्यामः च विविधान् क्वचित् पानानि भागशः |
क्वचिद् अन्न अवशेषाणि पश्यन् वै विचचार ह
verses.iast:
kvacid bhakṣyāmḥ ca vividhān kvacit pānāni bhāgaśaḥ |
kvacid anna avaśeṣāṇi paśyan vai vicacāra ha
verses.translation: Hanuma paced about seeing at some places various eatables and at some places drinks separately, and at some places remnants of cooked rice.

verses.devanagari:
क्वचित् प्रभिन्नैः करकैः क्वचिद् आलोडितैर् घटैः |
क्वचित् सम्पृक्त माल्यानि जलानि च फलानि च
verses.iast:
kvacit prabhinnaiḥ karakaiḥ kvacid āloḍitair ghaṭaiḥ |
kvacit sampṛkta mālyāni jalāni ca phalāni ca
verses.translation: Hanuma saw some places with vessels broken, some places with pots in shambles, some places with water together with flower garlands and fruits.

verses.devanagari:
शयनानि अत्र नारीणाम् शून्यानि बहुधा पुनः |
परस्परम् समाश्लिष्य काश्चित् सुप्ता वर अन्गनाः
verses.iast:
śayanāni atra nārīṇām śūnyāni bahudhā punaḥ |
parasparam samāśliṣya kāścit suptā vara anganāḥ
verses.translation: Here couches again of women were varied and clean, some best women slept there hugging one another.

verses.devanagari:
काचिच् च वस्त्रम् अन्यस्या अपह्ऱ्त्य उपगुह्य च |
उपगम्य अबला सुप्ता निद्रा बल पराजिता
verses.iast:
kācic ca vastram anyasyā apahRtya upaguhya ca |
upagamya abalā suptā nidrā bala parājitā
verses.translation: Some women conquered by the power of sleep pulled other sleeping women's clothing and slept covering themselves.

glosses.meaning: conquered by the power of sleep

verses.devanagari:
तासाम् उच्च्वास वातेन वस्त्रम् माल्यम् च गात्रजम् |
न अत्यर्थम् स्पन्दते चित्रम् प्राप्य मन्दम् इव अनिलम्
verses.iast:
tāsām uccvāsa vātena vastram mālyam ca gātrajam |
na atyartham spandate citram prāpya mandam iva anilam
verses.translation: Clothing and garland on the throats of those women was moving slightly and wonderfully as though obtaining air from the air of breath.

verses.devanagari:
चन्दनस्य च शीतस्य शीधोर् मधु रसस्य च |
विविधस्य च माल्यस्य पुष्पस्य विविधस्य च
बहुधा मारुतः तत्र गन्धम् विविधम् उद्वहन् |
verses.iast:
candanasya ca śītasya śīdhor madhu rasasya ca |
vividhasya ca mālyasya puṣpasya vividhasya ca
bahudhā mārutaḥ tatra gandham vividham udvahan |
verses.translation: There wind blew carrying in a lot of directions, a variety of fragrances of cool sandal-paste and of sweet liquor, of various flower garlands and of various kinds of agallocum fumes.

glosses.meaning: and of various kinds of agallocum fumes.

verses.devanagari:
स्नानानाम् चन्दनानाम् च धूपानाम् चैव मूर्चितः |
प्रववौ सुरभिर् गन्धो विमाने पुष्पके तदा
verses.iast:
snānānām candanānām ca dhūpānām caiva mūrcitaḥ |
pravavau surabhir gandho vimāne puṣpake tadā
verses.translation: Then the blossoming fragrance from the baths and sandal paste and from agallocum fumes blew spreading all around in that Pushpaka plane.

glosses.meaning: from the baths and sandal paste

verses.devanagari:
श्याम अवदाताः तत्र अन्याः काश्चित् कृष्णा वर अन्गनाः
काश्चित् कान्चन वर्ण अन्ग्यः प्रमदा राक्षस आलये |
verses.iast:
śyāma avadātāḥ tatra anyāḥ kāścit kṛṣṇā vara anganāḥ
kāścit kāncana varṇa angyaḥ pramadā rākṣasa ālaye |
verses.translation: There in that Ravana's house, some women had fair and white complexion some best women were black, some women had a body of golden complexion.

glosses.meaning: had a body of golden complexion.

verses.devanagari:
तासाम् निद्रा वशत्वाच् च मदनेन विमूर्चितम्
पद्मिनीनाम् प्रसुप्तानाम् रूपम् आसीद् यथैव हि |
verses.iast:
tāsām nidrā vaśatvāc ca madanena vimūrcitam
padminīnām prasuptānām rūpam āsīd yathaiva hi |
verses.translation: Appearance of those sleeping women, tired from being possessed by sleep and from lust, was like lotuses sleeping.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् सर्वम् अशेषेण रावण अन्तः पुरम् कपिः
ददर्श सुमहा तेजा न ददर्श च जानकीम् |
verses.iast:
evam sarvam aśeṣeṇa rāvaṇa antaḥ puram kapiḥ
dadarśa sumahā tejā na dadarśa ca jānakīm |
verses.translation: Hanuma with great radiance thus saw entire Ravana's house completely but did not see Seetha.

verses.devanagari:
निरीक्षमाणः च ततः ताः स्त्रियः स महा कपिः
जगाम महतीम् चिन्ताम् धर्म साध्वस शन्कितः |
verses.iast:
nirīkṣamāṇaḥ ca tataḥ tāḥ striyaḥ sa mahā kapiḥ
jagāma mahatīm cintām dharma sādhvasa śankitaḥ |
verses.translation: Then that Hanuma seeing those women obtained great anguish being in doubt because of fear in the matter of dharma.

glosses.meaning: being in doubt because of fear in the matter of dharma.

verses.devanagari:
पर दार अवरोधस्य प्रसुप्तस्य निरीक्षणम्
इदम् खलु मम अत्यर्थम् धर्म लोपम् करिष्यति |
verses.iast:
para dāra avarodhasya prasuptasya nirīkṣaṇam
idam khalu mama atyartham dharma lopam kariṣyati |
verses.translation: "My seeing sleeping house of other people's wives will do a great deficit to dharma."

verses.devanagari:
न हि मे पर दाराणाम् दृष्टिर् विषय वर्तिनी
अयम् च अत्र मया दृष्टः पर दार परिग्रहः |
verses.iast:
na hi me para dārāṇām dṛṣṭir viṣaya vartinī
ayam ca atra mayā dṛṣṭaḥ para dāra parigrahaḥ |
verses.translation: "My sight is indeed not in the matter of other wives here. These other's wives have been seen by me."

glosses.meaning: in the matter of others wives

verses.devanagari:
तस्य प्रादुर् अभूच् चिन्ता पुनर् अन्या मनस्विनः
निश्चित एक अन्त चित्तस्य कार्य निश्चय दर्शिनी |
verses.iast:
tasya prādur abhūc cintā punar anyā manasvinaḥ
niścita eka anta cittasya kārya niścaya darśinī |
verses.translation: To that Hanuma with an excellent mind, with a fixed and concentrated mind, was born another thought again, showing a fixed resolve in the task at hand.

glosses.meaning: with a fixed and concentrated mind
showing a fixed resolve in the task at hand.

verses.devanagari:
कामम् दृष्ट्वा मया सर्वा विश्वस्ता रावण स्त्रियः
न तु मे मनसः किंचिद् वैकृत्यम् उपपद्यते |
verses.iast:
kāmam dṛṣṭvā mayā sarvā viśvastā rāvaṇa striyaḥ
na tu me manasaḥ kiṃcid vaikṛtyam upapadyate |
verses.translation: "All Ravana's women who were in faith could have been seen by me; to my mind there indeed was not even a little disturbance".

verses.devanagari:
मनो हि हेतुः सर्वेषाम् इन्द्रियाणाम् प्रवर्तते
शुभ अशुभास्व् अवस्थासु तच् च मे सुव्यवस्थितम् |
verses.iast:
mano hi hetuḥ sarveṣām indriyāṇām pravartate
śubha aśubhāsv avasthāsu tac ca me suvyavasthitam |
verses.translation: "Among auspicious or inauspicious states in the behavior of all senses mind is the reason. My that mind is very steady."

verses.devanagari:
न अन्यत्र हि मया शक्या वैदेही परिमार्गितुम्
स्त्रियो हि स्त्रीषु द्ऱ्श्यन्ते सदा सम्परिमार्गणे |
verses.iast:
na anyatra hi mayā śakyā vaidehī parimārgitum
striyo hi strīṣu dRśyante sadā samparimārgaṇe |
verses.translation: "By me it is not possible to search Seetha at another place. Always during search women will be seen among other women."

verses.devanagari:
यस्य सत्त्वस्य या योनिः तस्याम् तत् परिमार्ग्यते
न शक्यम् प्रमदा नष्टा मृगीषु परिमार्गितुम् |
verses.iast:
yasya sattvasya yā yoniḥ tasyām tat parimārgyate
na śakyam pramadā naṣṭā mṛgīṣu parimārgitum |
verses.translation: "To an animal of whatever race that animal is searched in that race; a woman missing is not possible to be searched among female deer."

verses.devanagari:
तद् इदम् मार्गितम् तावत् शुद्धेन मनसा मया
रावण अन्तः पुरम् सरम् दृश्यते न च जानकी |
verses.iast:
tad idam mārgitam tāvat śuddhena manasā mayā
rāvaṇa antaḥ puram saram dṛśyate na ca jānakī |
verses.translation: "For that reason all this Ravana's house has been search by me with a pure mind Seetha alone cannot be seen."

verses.devanagari:
देव गन्धर्व कन्याः च नाग कन्याः च वीर्यवान्
अवेक्षमाणो हनुमान् न एव अपश्यत जानकीम् |
verses.iast:
deva gandharva kanyāḥ ca nāga kanyāḥ ca vīryavān
avekṣamāṇo hanumān na eva apaśyata jānakīm |
verses.translation: The strong Hanuma observing girls from devas, gandharvas and girls from nagas did not see Janaki.

verses.devanagari:
ताम् अपश्यन् कपिः तत्र पश्यमः च अन्या वर स्त्रियः
अपक्रम्य तदा वीरः प्रध्यातुम् उपचक्रमे |
verses.iast:
tām apaśyan kapiḥ tatra paśyamḥ ca anyā vara striyaḥ
apakramya tadā vīraḥ pradhyātum upacakrame |
verses.translation: The powerful Hanuma not seeing Her there and seeing other best women then started to think deeply going far from there.

verses.devanagari:
स भूयस्तु परम् श्रीमान् मारुतिर्यत्नमास्थितः
अपानभूमिमुत्सृज्य तद्विचेतुम् प्रचक्रमे |
verses.iast:
sa bhūyastu param śrīmān mārutiryatnamāsthitaḥ
apānabhūmimutsṛjya tadvicetum pracakrame |
verses.translation: That Hanuma the glorious one adopting a great task again left that bar and began to search that house.
